name: ModelVariant121_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant121_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (six textured quads trail the camera part, then 64 particle boxes and 64 shaded lines burst in front of the slot while a glow quad pair cycles its texture frames and a full-screen flash fades); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, scatters the burst points, packs two texture images and enables a tint for requests from 100 up, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 1 once on the first frame of the burst, 2 after the burst duration (resetting the slot ambient) and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-138 and 268 images build it from the same source with GRAPHICS_DEFAULT_HEIGHT 256. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
